description:
## What

`Fetcher::URLValidator.max_validated_entries` is a class method that delegates to `validated_store.max_entries`. The comment above it says 'Legacy compatibility: max_validated_entries method-style accessor for the limit on tracked hostname/IP associations. Delegates to the store's actual limit.' Grep across the codebase shows no callers in `src/` or `spec/`.

## Why

This is the same 'dead shim preserved for API stability' pattern we just removed for the DNS shims (commit 8499e62). Zero callers, one-line delegation, 'legacy' comment. If anyone needs the limit, they can call `URLValidator.validated_store.max_entries` directly (which is the pattern the other validator methods use).

## How

Delete the method. The class-level `@@validated_store` lazy-init stays (used by `register_ip`, `purge_expired`, etc.).

## Done when

- Method removed
- Full spec suite still green
- `grep -rn 'max_validated_entries' src/ spec/` returns no hits
title: Cleanup: remove unused URLValidator.max_validated_entries shim
